name: AutomationDirect SD-HRY switch operating accessory
aliases: AutomationDirect SD-HRY switch operating accessory GA
summary: SD-HRY switch operating accessory arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: SD-HRY is the drawing identifier for switch operating accessory in AutomationDirect's Non-Fused Disconnects collection. An operating accessory connects or supports part of a selected switch mechanism. It is not the switching device itself and cannot establish the complete assembly envelope by itself.

For example, in a control-panel door with a selected handle and operating linkage, use the SD-HRY reference to coordinate shaft or handle interface, fixing access and door motion. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Power Products/Non-fused Disconnects/SD-HRY.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep shaft or handle interface, fixing access and door motion visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named SD-HRY drawing and its switch operating accessory role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
